kit_motion_contract_since_v28.physical_input: The raw scroll clock runs from 0 to 240. Count and pan keep their approved physical scroll distances; panEnd is 80 and namesEnd is 140.
kit_motion_contract_since_v28.trigger: A genuine scroll crossing raw clock 140 chooses meanings revealed at or above 140, or names only below 140. This is scroll-driven stage selection, not a free-running autoplay reveal.
kit_motion_contract_since_v28.duration: The full transition span takes 500 ms. A reversal starts from the current presentation pose, not from a reset endpoint. The remaining time is proportional to the remaining distance, at the same full-span speed.
kit_motion_contract_since_v28.render_clock: Reveal progress traverses presentation clock 140 to 300. The dot formation, pure-dot hold, glyph development and final text-resolution phases remain inside this half-second handoff.
kit_motion_contract_since_v28.interruption: Offscreen or hidden-document transitions pause at their current progress and resume from that pose. Resize/layout updates do not choose a new scroll target. Initial deep arrival settles to the appropriate existing pose.

approved_clinical_and_example_boundaries.general: Educational interpretation is not a diagnosis, a promise of prevention, a guaranteed health improvement, or a replacement for professional assessment.
approved_clinical_and_example_boundaries.device: Use virtually painless and no needles to handle rather than an absolute pain or no-lancet guarantee. Supplied device instructions remain authoritative.
approved_clinical_and_example_boundaries.turnaround: If using the approved two-working-day wording, retain from laboratory receipt; do not imply doorstep-to-results in two days.
approved_clinical_and_example_boundaries.lab_vs_prevention: The range-proof example rereads the same fixed hs-CRP measurement 2.1 mg/L from different reference perspectives. EVA does not change the laboratory measurement. Its illustrative laboratory reference is <5 mg/L, with laboratory variation explicit. The prevention threshold is >=2 mg/L on repeat testing, not a universal optimal interval or a diagnosis.

laboratory_reference.qualification: Within this illustrative reference interval. Laboratories may use different limits.
laboratory_reference.source_location: Adult serum reference range on PDF pages 8 and 10.

prevention_threshold.qualification: A risk-enhancing factor worth discussing if confirmed on more than one occasion, with wider cardiovascular and inflammatory context. It is not a universal optimal range, deficiency diagnosis or treatment target.
prevention_threshold.source_location: 2026 ACC/AHA dyslipidemia guideline Table 13, risk-enhancing factors.

range_interpretation_evidence.preserve: Keep repeat confirmation adjacent to the prevention interpretation, source links visible, and the single-reading limitation intact. Do not restore the former blanket 0–1 EVA-optimal interpretation in this proof chapter.

approved_clinical_and_example_boundaries.history: A change in results does not by itself establish its cause, persistence or the right treatment. Compare compatible units, tests and context.

trend_mode_interpretations.one_reading: Explain that hs-CRP can signal inflammation but does not identify its cause; the reported workout may influence the value. With only one reading, do not claim a demonstrated change from the person's prior level. The next question is how it compares with earlier readings.
trend_mode_interpretations.show_history: Explain that Alex's latest value is higher than the three earlier values. This demonstrates a rise in the fictional sequence, not its cause or persistence. The next question is whether the rise is temporary or persists.
trend_mode_interpretations.unchanged_evidence: Both modes keep the same latest 2.1 mg/L value, canonical 0.8/0.9/0.8/2.1 history, self-reported hard workout in the previous 24 hours, no recent illness reported, fictional disclosure and cause limitation.
trend_mode_interpretations.clinical_and_qa_distinction: The interpretation changes because the visible temporal evidence changes, not because the lab value, lab range or clinical finding has changed. Passing the seven local UI cases verifies the implemented copy and behavior; it does not establish a real diagnosis, workout causation, persistent elevation or customer health outcome.

current_alex_case.point: The latest result is higher than the earlier pattern. History shows the change; it does not tell whether the rise will persist.
current_alex_case.cause_limit: The reported workout may contribute but is not a proven cause. Draw-day notes, the full fictional history and uncertainty remain the same at all three explanation levels.

expanded_sample_dashboard.distinction: This is a separate illustrative sample-dashboard trajectory. It is not Alex's canonical history [0.8, 0.9, 0.8, 2.1]. Do not merge or overwrite either dataset to make the other match.
expanded_sample_dashboard.scope: The optional expanded dashboard also demonstrates broader-library markers. Preserve the caption that some markers are not in the 13-marker kit; their presence is not a kit-inclusion claim.

approved_clinical_and_example_boundaries.scores: Preserve biological-age and longevity-score input/availability qualifications. Do not claim that the 13-marker list alone guarantees every model output.
approved_clinical_and_example_boundaries.source_material: Historical original transcripts and methodology copy remain comparison material, not newly verified clinical evidence or current panel specifications.
